# unifi_mclag_domains (Data Source)

Lists MC-LAG domains on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List MC-LAG domains on the site via the Official API.
data "unifi_mclag_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing MC-LAG domains.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The MC-LAG domains defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the MC-LAG domain.
- `json` (String) The full MC-LAG domain record, including nested lags and peers, serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the MC-LAG domain entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`).
- `name` (String) The MC-LAG domain name.
